,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":16,"text":"看着在身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，苏天晴鬼使神差地伸手，在尾巴上用力薅了一把。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":31,"text":"再次听完这中二到能让人用脚趾扣出三室一厅的台词，苏天晴又陷入了沉默与思索。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":39,"text":"嘴上不搭调地回答着古书的话，苏天晴脑子里却也对现状有了个大概的了解。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":40},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":10,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null}]}]}
